description: This file defines an Android activity 'TextAlign' that demonstrates various text alignment techniques using the Android graphics API. It includes drawing text with different alignments, positioning text along a path, and rendering on a custom view.

classes.name: TextAlign
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating text alignment, position, and path drawing.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom Android View that performs the drawing of text with various alignments and along a path.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of 'SampleView'.

methods.name: makePath
methods.description: Creates a cubic Bezier path used for drawing text on a path.

methods.name: buildTextPositions
methods.description: Calculates the positions for each character of the text to be drawn along a path.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor initializing paint objects, path, and text positions.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Performs all the drawing operations to render text with various alignments and on a path.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Updates the X position for text centering when view size changes.
